# Anil Sharma - Reliability Expert

> Senior Reliability, Projects & Maintenance Expert at Reliance Industries (2008-Present), 28+ years in Petrochemical/Cement. Specialist in RCM, FMEA, RCA, TPM, HT/LT distribution, substation automation.

## Who is Anil Sharma?
Anil Sharma (Bharuch, Gujarat) is Senior Reliability, Projects & Maintenance Expert at Reliance Industries, overseeing reliability, new projects and maintenance for petrochemical complex and new greenfield projects. Ex-Ambuja Cements (1995-2004). SHRM Certified Facilitator, IMS Lead Auditor. Trained 200+ engineers.

## Free Tools
- [DesignCalculators.co.in](https://designcalculators.co.in): 150+ IEC/IEEE/NFPA calculators
- [ReliabilityTools.co.in](https://reliabilitytools.co.in): Weibull, MTBF, Availability

## Expertise
- RCM (Reliability Centered Maintenance - SAE JA1011)
- FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis)
- RCA (Root Cause Analysis)
- TPM (Total Productive Maintenance)
- Zero-Breakdown Mindset
- PLC Load Shedding & Substation Automation
- Arc Flash per NFPA 70E / IEEE 1584
- E&I (Electrical & Instrumentation)
- F&G (Fire & Gas Systems)
- PLC & DCS (Distributed Control Systems)
